prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished high-fidelity desktop website design concept, Russian language, landscape canvas 1536x1024, entire page from compact header to simple footer. Zapominalnya educational website, new paper-and-blue-ink editorial style. White background #ffffff, dark ink #172229, muted #56627A, blue #284BB2, cream paper #fbfbf9, pale yellow and pale blue only in illustrations. Georgia regular large serif headlines (65px main, 32px collection name, 28px secondary), blue italic second line, Inter-style sans text 18px intro, 16px body, 14px captions. Content maximum 1200px with generous margins. Detailed fine blue ballpoint pen crosshatched hand drawn educational illustration with subtle yellow paper accents, NOT generic 3d. Crisp readable real Russian copy. Header brand text only "Запоминальня" on left (do not invent or draw a logo), nav "Каталог курсов", "Подборки", "Блог", "Тарифы", right "Войти", blue button "Создать аккаунт". Main exact headline "Меньше искать." then "Больше разбираться." Intro exact "Курсы по одной теме, собранные редакцией. Выберите то, что интересно сейчас, и переходите к учёбе." There is ONLY ONE published collection, exact name "К первому зачёту", description "Три технических курса для подготовки: основы вероятностей и анализа данных, устройство Git и работа с удалённым репозиторием.", action "Посмотреть курсы". No invented collections, tabs, search, course names, stats, category chips or ratings. Below main collection, secondary section exact title "Учитесь по своему конспекту", copy "Создайте карточки или импортируйте готовый набор.", secondary outlined button "Создать карточки". Small footer links "Каталог", "Блог", "Войти". Buttons modest rounded corners, ink crosshatch blue texture. No perspective mockup, no device frame, no concept annotations or labels. COMPOSITION A — A folder on the study desk. Top hero left aligned occupying upper third, a small drawn index file on upper right. Below a single generous landscape cream folder-like card spanning content width, tab 'Выбор редакции' on top left. The left 40 percent contains beautiful blue pen illustration of open folder, loose revision notes and notebook. Right 60 percent contains collection title, full description and filled blue action. Bottom secondary create CTA is a calm horizontal narrow band. Compact overall rhythm, about 95px whitespace below header then hero, main card around 340px tall. Clear readable layout.
